name: Meter / Context Window
description: Context Window product scenario for the Meter component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Finite measured value; values outside min..max are bounded. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Finite lower bound, strictly below max. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Finite upper bound, strictly above min. Defaults to 100.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name when no visible label is present, or an explicit name override.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: IDs of external naming elements; takes precedence over label and aria-label.

controls.name: aria-valuetext
controls.description: Speech-only value description; formatValue controls visible text as well.

controls.name: tone
controls.description: Semantic feedback color, independent of the numeric value. Defaults to neutral.

controls.name: shape
controls.description: Linear bar or circular ring; both display the same exact fraction. Defaults to linear.

controls.name: showValue
controls.description: Show formatted value text. Unknown task progress never displays a numeric value.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Noninteractive visible label. Name an unlabelled indicator with native aria-label or aria-labelledby.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the complete indicator. Defaults to true.
